spellbook.finance/limitations: Limitless observations cover the previous 30 days and do not measure the whole player population or predict demand.
Format rotation legality is not inferred from observed decklists.
Coverage and truncation fields qualify incomplete source observations; absence is unknown, not zero usage.

description: Read observed Pokemon archetype coverage for one format from recent Limitless tournament decklists. The response preserves archetype facts, sample coverage, truncation, missingFields and limitations. It does not measure the whole player population or predict demand.

limit.description: Maximum archetypes to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.
